ValidationRule.description: Requires a 4-digit year that is 2025 or greater.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Published_Year__c)), OR( LEN(Published_Year__c) <> 4, NOT(ISNUMBER(Published_Year__c)), VALUE(Published_Year__c) < 2025, VALUE(Published_Year__c) > YEAR(TODAY()) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Published Year must be a 4-digit year and can't be in the future.
